title: Store and Display Student Details
description:
Read a student name (line 1), age as an integer (line 2), and grade/class as an integer (line 3) from input. Print:
`Name: <name>, Age: <age>, Grade: <grade>`
instructions: Read 3 lines from standard input: name (string), age (int), grade (int).
Format the output on a single line exactly as shown.
hints: Read all lines from stdin and parse age and grade as integers.
Use string interpolation or concatenation to format commas and spaces exactly.

starterCode.python:
name = input().strip()
age = int(input().strip())
grade = int(input().strip())
# Print formatted student details
